sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Safety Responsibility

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Minimums split three ways, thirty thousand dollars for one person, sixty thousand dollars for two or more, and twenty-five thousand dollars for property [A01].
Why it matters: group minimum-limits; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
Proof is shown routinely at licensing, registration, and inspection, yet on demand to officers and crash counterparts [A01].
Why it matters: group proof-duties; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
Both the comptroller certificate and the county-judge certificate rest on fifty-five thousand dollars deposited, while self-insurance rests on owning more than twenty-five vehicles [A01].
Why it matters: group proof-types; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
A citation for missing proof dies when coverage existed, but conviction without coverage brings fines and worse [A01].
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F06, sec03-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A01
First convictions end in fines alone, while second and later ones add suspension, bigger fines, and a one-hundred-eighty-day impoundment [A01].
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F06; confusables sec03-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A02
Crash judgments must be satisfied within sixty days, while proof itself must be kept two years from the latest conviction [A02].
Why it matters: group suspension-triggers; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F08, sec03-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A02
An uninsured crash triggers suspension review through death, injury, or one thousand dollars of property damage with likely judgment [A02].
Why it matters: group suspension-triggers; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F08; confusables sec03-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0025]

corpus_stability.reason: The Texas Driver Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so Section Three responsibility rules change at most with new editions.
